lower_competition.support: two independent supported pairs conditional on owned notes and upper partials
lower_competition.comparison: upper must survive each supported lower full harmonic series
lower_competition.overflow: withhold; never truncate candidates or owned notes
lower_competition.lower_frequency: valid saved phase; otherwise equal temperament for support, training-only fit for comparison

scope.rule_change: After original admission, condition on every independently supported unowned lower candidate observed at the training cutoff; retain the upper only if it survives each full lower harmonic model. Lower hypotheses alone cannot veto. No labels or future state select candidates; no threshold sweep.

limitations: This offline screen cannot establish native deadlines, processing allocations, buffers or external host/device delivery.

Shared assignment can still lose a passage after any added note; all passage losses reject the screen.
Recorded lower62 is an observed alternative explanation, not established source separation.
